_comment: Maps a mod folder to its Nexus Mods page. Only mods listed here can be released by
.github/workflows/release.yml -- the workflow's mod dropdown is built from this list.
page_id is the number in the mod page URL, e.g. nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14379.
Used only to build links; the v3 API calls it game_scoped_id.
mod_id  is the v3 API's GLOBAL mod id, which is NOT the number in the URL. The upload
file_id is the v3 mod-file the action appends a version to, via
/v3/mod-files/{file_id}/versions. It cannot create a mod page or a new file.
To re-derive these for a new mod, with an API key in $NEXUS_API_KEY:
Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.
